title: Galt's Gulch Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: Located 10 minutes from Sunday River mountain and situated in the idyllic town of Bethel, Galt's Gulch is a gorgeous ski chalet that will make all your troubles melt away. Whether you’re looking to ski, snowshoe, hike or simply unwind with family and friends -- your wonderland awaits at Galt's Gulch. Our chalet offers an expansive great room with a cozy fireplace, exposed wood cathedral ceilings and a beautiful kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and dining area. A wrap around porch with gas grill and outdoor seating offers some of the best sunrise and sunset views over a neighboring mountain. Just off the porch is a screened in section with a hot tub - perfect for relaxing your muscles after a long day of adventure. There are 2 queen bedrooms located off the kitchen/living space. Both rooms offer ample closets and TVs. These two guest bedrooms share a hall bath with shower/tub combo. Upstairs is a king master retreat with TV, private en suite with separate tub and shower and dual sinks. On the terrace level, guests will enjoy a large mudroom to drop/store all of your ski supplies as well as a full laundry space. This level also offers a second living space/game room complete with TV, ping pong and air hockey table. The 4th bedroom is on this level with dual queen bunks, lots of storage space, and a 3rd full bathroom with bath/shower combo. Our home is situated on 1.5 acres with a great front yard perfect for sledding and a backyard complete with fire pit and woods to snowshoe through. We are 5 minutes to the Bethel Inn and downtown area with restaurants and shops and 10 minutes to Sunday River and all the winter activities you could want.
